name: Zhaojian Li
title: Red Cedar Distinguished Professor; RIVAL director (academic-rank wording differs across current MSU sources)
department: Mechanical Engineering; Electrical and Computer Engineering affiliation
fitReason: Strong current physical-AI fit: vision foundation models guide an actual dual-arm harvester, with a complementary soft-robot RL/control collaboration.

physicalEvidence.summary: June 12, 2026 paper validates a custom dual-arm apple harvester with Grounding-DINO detection, fine-tuned EfficientViT-SAM segmentation, RGB-D localization and CBF-constrained arm motion. Two commercial-orchard trials occurred during the 2025 harvest season, comprising 1,738 arm cycles; robot transport between stops is human-operated. Learned perception guides picking, while temporal-logic coordination and low-level trajectory control are not RL. September 2026 MSU reporting confirms the same research program remains active. Separate June 2026 soft-arm PPO triggering is collaborative Mississippi State-led hardware, not evidence of his own MSU soft-arm installation.

shortVisit.summary: Current MSU faculty directory and RIVAL site verify the PI role; current institutional reports identify his research team. No explicit external-master’s short-visit invitation was verified. Lab homepage’s main news list ends in 2024, so 2026 activity is sourced independently.

name: Xiaobo Tan
title: MSU Research Foundation Distinguished Professor; Richard M. Hong Endowed Chair; Associate Chair for Research; Smart Microsystems Laboratory director
department: Electrical and Computer Engineering; Mechanical Engineering affiliation
fitReason: Relevant soft-robot and learned-control collaboration, with a hardware-centered local laboratory. Recent concrete RL deployment is collaborative rather than verified current own-lab execution.

physicalEvidence.summary: Coauthors June 24, 2026 PPO-triggered DeePC on an actual three-tendon soft arm with Arduino actuation, OptiTrack feedback and host-PC inference. RL chooses optimizer invocation, with 34% fewer hardware optimization calls and retuned penalty settings. First authors and lead PI are at Mississippi State, so this does not verify Tan’s own current arm installation. His MSU SML independently develops physical soft and aquatic robots; September 2025 DiSA-IQL is simulation-only and is not counted as hardware.
